quote: Proposition 1. The following statements hold. (i) If random variable X satisfies (SD), then either X is a constant, or E[|X|] is infinite. (ii) If two independent random variables X and Y satisfy (SD), then X + Y satisfies (SD). (iii) If random variable X satisfies (SD), then (X + a)/b satisfies (SD) for all a ∈ R and b ∈ R++ . (iv) If random variable Yk with any k ∈ N satisfies (SD) and Yk →d X, then X satisfies (SD).

quote: Proposition 2. If F ∈ H, then ϕ(x1 , x2 ) = F (1/x1 ) + F (1/x2 ), (x1 , x2 ) ∈ R2++ , is Schur-concave. Conversely, if F is continuous and ϕ is Schur-concave, F ∈ H. In addition, if F has density f , then F ∈ H if and only if x2 f (x) is increasing in x ∈ R++ .
